q1_issues.issue: (Experiencer sk_moth_count_1 east_row) hangs a thematic role on sk_moth_count_1, which is typed as the entity moth_count rather than as a reified state, and lines 52-53 then put the eventuality-only Time and Past heads on that same non-eventuality.

The reified count witness carries the time (third_watch) but no value, while the value 7 sits in the separate flat (Past (Measure east_row moth_count 7 unspecified)) with no time, so 'seven at the third watch' is never joined.

S7 mints a moth_count entity while the parallel S2 clause ('the moth-count at each lantern ... was about twenty-five') encodes the same construction as a bare Measure on the location with no count entity, so one passage gets two incompatible encodings of one construction.

(Patient sk_hunt_1 sk_preymoths_1) - hunting does not create, destroy, consume or physically change its object, and the instruction set's tie-breaker ('when the test is unclear, default to Theme') points to Theme.

q2_gaps: A time adjunct on a measured value ('the moth-count ... was seven AT THE THIRD WATCH'): Measure has no Time slot, tense only wraps it, and the copular-with-time-modifier reification is defined for adjectival property states, so there is no licensed carrier for when a quantity held.
A day-index within a year ('on DAY 0 of Year 1'): the (Day <n>) term is the calendar day-of-month slot; a 'day N of Year Y' ordinal-day calendar has no defined encoding.
A passage-initial date frame ('On day 0 of Year 1, ...'): nothing states whether it scopes over the following sentences, so only the first clause ends up dated.
notes: Compound decomposition, the Cliff Path / East Row / Hollows name handling, the counted-group + per-member-rule pattern for the sky-cats, and the 'each nightmoth that survived' relative-clause universal all follow the instruction set closely. The one structurally broken block is S7's reified moth-count.
